en_before: Alternative fashion and streetwear often overlap through graphic tees, cargos, wide denim, sneakers, and oversized shapes, but the terms are not interchangeable. Streetwear has its own histories and references, while alternative fashion is a broader label for non-mainstream or subculturally influenced directions. An outfit may belong to both when its styling, graphics, texture, and accessories establish that overlap.
